answer: Each submission hangs on the nebula of a task receipt, and the karst is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the summit of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
